# Results (auto-generated by scripts/run_experiments.py)

Cases: 357 paired cases = 9 base tasks x 3 seeds x variants (clean, 4 A, 4 B, 5 C; C_condition only where the task has a condition). All numbers come from scripted, deterministic model stand-ins (see docs/02_threat_model.md); they characterise the *defense structure*, not any real LLM.

## 1. Main results (k = 2 verification calls, phi = 1, rho = 1, omega = 0)

Utility = exact task success (expected side effects only, no escalation). CUA = committed unauthorized action (any side effect outside the correct execution). All rates are over cases of the given family.

## 5. Pre-registered NO_GO checks (computed)

Cost is counted as LLM calls + verification calls (one unit each; verification is EP's main spend, so this is conservative against EP). 'Improves' requires a paired-bootstrap CI that excludes 0 on utility or CUA, and no worsening in the mean of the other.

| strong existing defense (same references, tools, k) | Δ util (pp) | Δ CUA (pp) | Δ over-refusal (pp) | Δ verify / Δ LLM calls | verdict | same framework + EP's endorsement rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CaMeL (strong plan) | +10.1 | +0.0 | -25.5 | +0.00 / +0.00 | improves at <= cost | CaMeL + endorsement: identical outcomes |
| Fides (strong plan) | +20.2 | -13.6 | -10.6 | +0.31 / -2.54 | improves at <= cost | Fides (typed endorsement): identical outcomes |
| Fides (arg-level P-T) | +17.6 | +0.0 | -36.2 | -0.35 / -2.54 | improves at <= cost | Fides (typed endorsement): identical outcomes |
| AgentSentry | +26.9 | -32.7 | +0.0 | +0.87 / -5.82 | improves at <= cost | AgentSentry + verify prompt: identical outcomes |
| AgentSentry + verify prompt | +0.0 | +0.0 | +0.0 | +0.07 / -5.79 | no improvement | AgentSentry + verify prompt: identical outcomes |
| Tool filter | +51.3 | -59.1 | +0.0 | +0.87 / -0.67 | gain needs more cost (NO_GO) | - |

* Deny-all check: EP utility 97% vs deny-all 0%; EP over-refusal on clean+C 0%.
* Extra-oracle check: every defense has the same references and k. Removing endorsement from EP (same references, same k) drops util C from 100% to 55%: the C gain comes from how the shared reference is used (endorsement), not from access to it.
* Reference-alone check: ignoring documents and using the references alone gives util C 55% (lookup-capable references suffice; confirm-only ones do not, see section 3).
